articles.title: Armando “La Hormiga” González leaves Mexico after a difficult summer and begins a new adventure in Europe
articles.standfirst: The Mexican forward says goodbye to his country.
articles.summary: The Mexican forward says goodbye to his country.
articles.body:
The Mexican forward arrived in Athens on August 21 to begin his spell with Olympiacos, leaving Chivas behind and , with it, a summer that ended up being much more complicated than he could have imagined when the year began.

But who is “La Hormiga” González?

For many fans outside Mexico, his name may still be new. In Guadalajara, however, he has been showing for some time that he could become one of the country’s most important young forwards .

Born on April 20, 2003, in Celaya, Guanajuato, González came through Chivas’ youth academy and played for Tapatío before making his first-team debut in 2023. His development accelerated over the past year, when he scored 24 goals between the Apertura 2025 and Clausura 2026 .

His big breakthrough came in the Apertura 2025. With 12 goals, he finished as the Liga MX top scorer , sharing the honor with other players.

The 2026 World Cup opened a door that closed far too soon

That performance earned González a call-up to the Mexican national team and eventually took him to the 2026 World Cup .

He arrived at the tournament with a story that seemed perfect for a young forward: Chivas’ top scorer, a promising young player and a first World Cup opportunity in front of his home crowd . But reality turned out to be very different.

Javier Aguirre gave him just 14 minutes against South Africa . After that match, González did not play another minute during the World Cup.

Mexico were eliminated by England in the Round of 16, and the forward was seen crying after the match, aware that his long-awaited World Cup debut had not gone the way he had hoped.

And he still had to return to Guadalajara.

A problem Chivas had not planned for emerged

After the World Cup, González returned to Guadalajara to play in the Apertura 2026 and the Leagues Cup .

The problem appeared in an area he knew all too well: scoring goals .

Statistically, he was no longer the same dominant forward who had arrived at the World Cup. And just when he needed to rediscover that version of himself, a difficult possibility for Chivas fans began to take shape: seeing him leave for another country .

Greece appeared at the least expected moment

Olympiacos decided to bet on González and put a $12 million deal on the table, along with a five-year contract. Chivas retained 20% of his rights in anticipation of a future sale.

The move is particularly striking because of when it happened.

“Money is not the main thing,” and there is a reason behind it

Before leaving for Europe, González said that money was not what he was primarily looking for.

His priority, he explained, is his development as a footballer.

And there is a specific goal behind that decision: the Champions League .

The forward has acknowledged that playing in a European competition has been one of his goals since he was a child. Olympiacos cannot offer him that competition immediately, but it can give him a new setting to begin building a path toward it, something that would be difficult to achieve in Mexico, especially after experiencing a World Cup in which he barely had opportunities .

articles.title: The Liga MX doesn't stop during the FIFA international break: Matchday 10 will be played while Mexico faces Colombia
articles.standfirst: Matchday 10 of the Apertura 2026 will be played between September 25 and 27 despite the FIFA international break, with several clubs affected by the call-ups of their players to the national teams.
articles.summary: Matchday 10 of the Apertura 2026 will be played between September 25 and 27 despite the FIFA international break, with several clubs affected by the call-ups of their players to the national teams.
articles.body:
The Mexican championship will continue this weekend despite the friendlies of the Mexican National Team against Colombia and Peru. The schedule was adjusted after the 2026 Leagues Cup and forced the staging of another matchday during the international window.

The international break will alter the activity of much of world football, but the Mexican tournament will continue with its 18 teams between Friday, September 25 and Sunday, September 27.

The clubs will play without their internationals

While several of the world's top leagues pause for the FIFA international window, Liga MX will remain active . Matchday 10 of the Apertura 2026 will be played this weekend and will once again put all 18 clubs in the competition into action.

The particularity of this date is that some teams will have to face their matches with players called up by their respective national teams. 11 of the 18 teams in the league will be affected by this measure. Even so, the schedule will not be suspended and there will be nine matches spread between Friday, September 25 and Sunday, September 27.

When is Matchday 10 of Liga MX played?

The action will begin on Friday with two matches. Atlante will host Monterrey at 7:00 PM, while Tijuana will face Atlas at 9:00 PM. Matchday 10 will continue on Saturday with four games and will conclude on Sunday with three more.

* Atlante vs. Monterrey — 7:00 PM

* Tijuana vs. Atlas — 9:00 PM

* Cruz Azul vs. Toluca — 4:50 PM

* Chivas vs. Querétaro — 17:07 hours

*Santos vs. Pachuca — 21:05 hours

* Tigres vs. Puebla — 21:10 hours

* Pumas vs. Atlético de San Luis — 12:00 hours

* León vs. FC Juárez — 7:00 PM

* Necaxa vs. América — 21:10 hours

Which players will miss Matchday 10 of the Apertura 2026?

The Liga MX footballers called up by Rafael Márquez are one of the main sources of absences for Matchday 10. However, not all of them will miss the round: Chivas received authorization to use four of its national team players before they join the Mexican National Team.

Absences also affect players called up by other national teams . Among them are Kevin Mier of Cruz Azul and Óscar Perea of América, called up by Colombia; Santiago Simón of Toluca, called up by Argentina; and Rodrigo Aguirre of Tigres, called up by Uruguay.

League MX usually pauses its activity during international windows. This time there will be no break and the clubs will play Matchday 10 of the Apertura 2026 while the national teams fulfill their commitments.

Mexico will begin its friendly match schedule on Saturday, September 26 against Colombia, in Baltimore.

The second friendly will be against Peru on September 29. After that, Mexico will face the United States on October 3 and Chile on October 6, as part of the same international window.

articles.title: Rafa Márquez's gesture toward Gilberto Mora that puts him on par with Messi
articles.standfirst: Rafa Márquez's message is clear: the young player must be the star of this National Team, a number worn by greats such as Pelé, Maradona, Messi, Puskas, and now also Lamine Yamal, among others
articles.summary: Rafa Márquez's message is clear: the young player must be the star of this National Team, a number worn by greats such as Pelé, Maradona, Messi, Puskas, and now also Lamine Yamal, among others
articles.body:
Rafa Márquez does nothing without a reason. The fact that Gilberto Mora wore the number 10 jersey for the national team on the day of the coach’s debut on the bench is no coincidence. It is a message to the football world, but especially to the player himself. The new Mexico head coach is telling his player that he is a star with a tremendous future . And the best part is that Gilberto more than delivered. He had a fantastic match and showed that he is more than capable of wearing that number reserved for the greatest. The message has been received, and not only in Mexico. Gilberto is destined to become one of the greats as long as they continue to take good care of him.

Do not forget that Messi still wears that 10, but so did footballers like Maradona or Pelé. On another tier in football history, that number is worn by geniuses. Zidane wore it during part of his career, although at Madrid he wore the 5, but also players like Ronaldinho , Riquelme, Puskas, Laudrup, Platini, Mbappé or Zico, among others. True football monsters.

The number 10 at the big teams is usually always worn, with few exceptions, by the best player. The different footballer, the one with a different talent , capable of carrying a team on his back and turning a match around all by himself. At Barcelona they have also given it to Lamine Yamal , only one year older than Gilberto Mora, but already a clear candidate to win the Ballon d'Or in competition with another number 10, Mbappé.

For all these reasons, the fact that a youngster about to turn 18 years old has already been given the No. 10 for a national team like Mexico is no coincidence. It is a sign that Rafa Márquez has handed him the full weight of his team despite his youth. It is a demonstration of trust, and he has told him that he can reach the very top. Naturally, comparing him with those names who have worn that number would now be a mistake, but the coach has given him the team’s leadership with that gesture. And Gilberto more than delivered with a true stunner against a great national team like Colombia . Beyond the thunderous right-footed strike, his cut inside the box is worthy of a football genius.

However, there’s no need to celebrate too soon. Gilberto has his entire footballing life ahead of him, and perhaps the hardest part still to come. To establish himself by proving that he is capable of making the most of and displaying that undeniable talent he has on any team in the world. Certainly, against Colombia that number did not weigh on him, despite it being the one worn by the greatest. He has time to confirm it, but Márquez has already chosen him as one of them.
